items.t: Semtech (SMTC) Could Find a Support Soon, Here's Why You Should Buy the Stock Now
items.sum: After losing some value lately, a hammer chart pattern has been formed for Semtech (SMTC), indicating that the stock has found support. This, combined with an upward trend in earnings estimate revisions, could lead to a trend reversal for the stock in the near term.

items.t: B. Riley Securities Maintains Buy on Semtech, Lowers Price Target to $190
items.sum: B. Riley Securities analyst Craig Kennison maintains Semtech (NASDAQ:SMTC) with a Buy and lowers the price target from $210 to $190.
